title: Tu peux pas laisser Ryan comme ça !  (Comforting Sofia)

segments.t: For once, Mathias has had enough of his star client's bad behavior — and back at the agency that evening, Gabriel checks in on Sofia after her day on the costume-drama shoot. Listen to the French first, without worrying about catching every word.
Parle à Camille. C'est elle qui l'a mise en place.
Calme-toi. Elle essaie de t'aider.
Ça suffit! Tu t'excuses et tu dégages!
Je vais te montrer que si!
Désolé, Sofia! Comment s'est passé ton tournage hier?
Très bien.
Il y a un problème, le film est trop long.
Ils vont peut-être couper ma scène.
Mais c'est pas grave. Le réalisateur t'a vue jouer.
Et il pensera à toi la prochaine fois. Ne te décourage pas.
Tu pars?
Ouais, j'y vais.
Moi aussi. T'as faim?
J'ai toujours faim, Sofia.
On va manger?
Avec plaisir.
Et, Gabriel, ça vous dérange si on se tutoie?
Non.
Let's walk through the scene line by line. First, Mathias deals with Jonathan Joubert on the soap-opera set.
Parle à Camille. C'est elle qui l'a mise en place.
'Talk to Camille. She's the one who set it up.' When Jonathan complains about the photo on the online petition, Mathias gives credit to Camille.
Calme-toi. Elle essaie de t'aider.
'Calm down. She's trying to help you.' Jonathan starts shouting at the director because he refuses to let his character Ryan cry on screen.
Ça suffit! Tu t'excuses et tu dégages!
'That's enough! You apologize and you get out!' When Jonathan insults both the director and head writer Marie-Sophie, Mathias finally loses his temper.
Je vais te montrer que si!

'I'm going to show you that I can!' Jonathan boasts that Mathias would never dare abandon his character Ryan — so Mathias drops him as a client on the spot, choosing Arlette's loyal screenwriter over the arrogant star.
Désolé, Sofia! Comment s'est passé ton tournage hier?
'Sorry, Sofia! How did your shoot go yesterday?' Back at ASK that evening, Gabriel stops by the reception desk to check on Sofia.
Très bien.
'Very well.' Trying to save face, Sofia pretends at first that everything went smoothly on the chateau set.
Il y a un problème, le film est trop long.
'There is a problem, the film is too long.' Rather than admit that her scene was cut before she even filmed it, she invents a gentle excuse.
Ils vont peut-être couper ma scène.
'They might cut my scene.' The near future 'they are going to' combines with 'maybe' and the infinitive 'to cut'.
Mais c'est pas grave. Le réalisateur t'a vue jouer.
'But it's no big deal. The director saw you act.' Gabriel has no idea that she never actually filmed the scene, and comforts her warmly.
Et il pensera à toi la prochaine fois. Ne te décourage pas.
'And he'll think of you next time. Don't lose heart.' Notice how 'to think of someone' uses the linking word 'at' followed by the stressed pronoun 'you'.
Tu pars?
'Are you leaving?' Literally 'Do you leave?' — present tense for an action happening right now.
Ouais, j'y vais.
'Yeah, I'm heading out.' The little pronoun for 'there' combines with 'I go' to make the everyday phrase for 'I'm off' or 'I'm heading out'.
Moi aussi. T'as faim?
'Me too. Are you hungry?' Remember that French expresses hunger as 'to have hunger'.
J'ai toujours faim, Sofia.
'I'm always hungry, Sofia.' Just as he told Andréa earlier in the car, Gabriel never turns down a meal.
On va manger?
'Shall we go eat?' A simple rising tone turns 'we go eat' into a friendly invitation.
Avec plaisir.
'With pleasure.' Polite, warm, and natural.
Et, Gabriel, ça vous dérange si on se tutoie?
'And, Gabriel, do you mind if we use tu with each other?' All this time, Gabriel has called Sofia 'tu' while she still addressed him formally as 'you'. Now she asks if they can be on equal footing.
Non.
'No.' One quiet word and a smile as they walk out of the agency together. Now let's hear the whole scene again from start to finish.
Parle à Camille. C'est elle qui l'a mise en place.
Calme-toi. Elle essaie de t'aider.
Ça suffit! Tu t'excuses et tu dégages!
Je vais te montrer que si!
Désolé, Sofia! Comment s'est passé ton tournage hier?
Très bien.
Il y a un problème, le film est trop long.
Ils vont peut-être couper ma scène.
Mais c'est pas grave. Le réalisateur t'a vue jouer.
Et il pensera à toi la prochaine fois. Ne te décourage pas.
Tu pars?
Ouais, j'y vais.
Moi aussi. T'as faim?
J'ai toujours faim, Sofia.
On va manger?
Avec plaisir.
Et, Gabriel, ça vous dérange si on se tutoie?
Non.
While Gabriel and Sofia head out to dinner together, Mathias is still in his office late at night — and he has one last important conversation waiting for him with Camille. See you next time!
À bientôt!
